thread:
olivia_ops: Heads up — we're seeing partner webhook enrichment latency causing usage to shift windows. Some events arrive on time but enrichment (sku mapping, entitlements) lags 2–7m, and the billing pipeline proration rules kick in.
ben_billing: Oof. Any examples of how this surfaces? Are we double-counting or losing credits?
olivia_ops: Mostly mismatched entitlements and small negative deltas when partner reports hourly vs our per-minute windowing. Example payload:
```json
{"ts":1718501200,"usage_units":12,"partner_id":"edgeco","event_id":"evt-123","enrichment":null}
```
Then enrichment arrives later with sku/plan info.
anya_eng: We saw this pattern in staging. Two options: 1) buffer window + finalize after enrichment TTL (e.g., 10m), or 2) accept provisional records and emit correction credits when enrichment arrives. Both have tradeoffs for SLA.
sam_product: Prefer not to delay visibility >2m for customers. Corrections are ok if small and visible in dashboard.
ben_billing: How would corrections show up? Would partners see negative credits? Need to avoid surprising invoices.
liam_partnerships: Also need partner-facing guidance. If we choose corrections, we should add a "pending_enrichment" flag in the webhook response so partners can trace.
ingest_bot: alert: enrichment-latency spike for source=edgeco — median=180s p95=410s (10:12–10:42)
anya_eng: Implementation idea: ingest writes a provisional usage row with status=provisional and seq_no. Enrichment consumer reconciles by seq_no and writes final row or credit row. We can keep provisional until max_ttl=600s then auto-finalize with best-effort mapping.
ben_billing: Sounds ok. Can we add a config per partner—some partners want immediate finalization, others accept corrections.
olivia_ops: Yes, per-partner policy + dashboard flag. Also add a metric for "correction_rate" and alert if >0.5% / day.
sam_product: UX: show a small badge "pending correction" on recent usage and an audit trail link.
liam_partnerships: I'll draft partner communication: explain that small reconciling credits may appear, and give steps to reduce by sending enriched events upstream sooner.
ben_billing: Next steps: Anya/eng to prototype provisional rows + seq_no. Olivia to run partner impact sims. Liam to draft partner note. We'll sync in 24h. :thumbsup: 
olivia_ops: thanks — filing a follow-up ticket and adding test cases to the replay harness.
